description: Start a requested VA connection for this signed-in account and assistant. Requires owner:va. Show connection_url to confirm the account and fields to share. Review saved verification or complete official VA sign-in, then approve sharing with this app. Verification is saved to the account only after approval. Call get_va_connection after browser return. The link alone grants no access. Never request passwords, tokens, SSNs or full VA documents in chat.
name: start_va_connection
